guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H4 display text. Never use sans-serif for headings.
Use EB Garamond for long-form paragraphs.
Use Josefin Sans for UI elements, buttons, nav links, and small overlines.
Use Pinyon Script exclusively for the Gift Card builder step.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C9A84C] text-[#1B1810] font-josefin uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#E8C97A] transition-colors duration-500
buttons.outline: border border-[#7A5C2E] text-[#E8C97A] font-josefin uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#231F17] hover:border-[#C9A84C] transition-all duration-500

cards.luxury_shell: bg-[#231F17] border border-[#7A5C2E]/30 rounded-none relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 hover:scale-[1.02] hover:border-[#C9A84C]/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(201,168,76,0)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(201,168,76,0.15)]

modals.glassmorphic: bg-[#FAF7F2]/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#FAF7F2]/20 shadow-2xl text-[#1B1810]

filter_pills.default: border border-[#7A5C2E] text-[#F5EDD6] rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-josefin text-sm hover:border-[#C9A84C] transition-all duration-300
filter_pills.active: bg-[#C9A84C] text-[#1B1810] border-[#C9A84C] rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-josefin text-sm shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(201,168,76,0.3)]

animation_utility_classes.reveal: opacity-0 translate-y-8 blur-sm transition-all duration-700 ease-in-out data-[in-view=true]:opacity-100 data-[in-view=true]:translate-y-0 data-[in-view=true]:blur-0
animation_utility_classes.forbidden: NO SHIMMER (e.g., animate-pulse or skeleton gradients). Use warm glow and slow fades.

instructions_to_main_agent.preloader: Cinematic preloader using #1A1510 background and #E8C97A text. Fade out smoothly, no abrupt jump.
instructions_to_main_agent.navbar: Fixed Navbar with mega dropdown. Glassmorphic backdrop-blur-md on scroll.
instructions_to_main_agent.hero: 100vh Hero section with image overlay. Copy: 'The Art of Gifting, Perfected.'
instructions_to_main_agent.builder: 5-step Bespoke Hamper Builder (vessels -> budget -> confections -> gift card -> AI assembly -> details). Use Framer Motion for smooth transitions. Modals must use #FAF7F2 interior.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent.motion: Use Framer Motion with spring physics. No shimmer.
